source_document: Rank Boost Email System, Complete Master v2
copy_standard: Qualified leads already passed the scan. State the known keyword, position, and incremental potential case-value gap directly.
Give each email one useful topic. Remove repeated disclaimers and redundant page-one eligibility reminders.
Keep free-boost preparation free of paid options and pricing. Book the follow-up before activation.
Show organic proof inline with accurate captions. Do not use Maps grids as organic proof.
Use dynamic fields and readable equations. Keep total potential at number one separate from incremental opportunity.
Close personally: I personally read every reply.
Website offers explain the search baseline and paid website consultation route. Re-evaluate Rank Boost after the site is live.

{% if subscriber.top_volume != blank and subscriber.ctr_position_1 != blank and subscriber.opp_clicks != blank and subscriber.lead_conversion_rate != blank and subscriber.opp_leads != blank and subscriber.close_rate != blank and subscriber.cases_per_month != blank and subscriber.case_value != blank and subscriber.opp_value != blank %}
